why: Narrower than claimed: links live 24h and are only reused while still live (0063:422, billing.js:45), so a 48h window covers a normal miss; but if the webhook fails AND the nightly check fails two nights running (fetchPaid error is only counted, billing.js:462-465), the payment ages out of the 48h list (0064:122) with no alert.

A failed WhatsApp send only writes console.error and marks the code dead (phoneCode.js:331-336); the Meta hook only writes log lines (whatsappHook.js:7); nothing in the panel cron or scripts/watch/outage.mjs counts or alerts on WhatsApp failures.

AADHAAR_IN_TEXT uses ASCII \d with only [\s-] separators and no u flag (importIds.ts:96), cellText does no digit normalising (importMembers.ts:496-510), while the AI step's DIGIT_RUN uses \p{Nd} and dots/slashes (aiImport.ts:49).

The assistant calls monthSummary(s.payments, s.expenses, month) with no shop orders (answer.ts:542), so shopP defaults to 0 (expenses.ts:139,145), while Expenses.tsx:73 passes orders; non-whole-month ranges also use fees only.

The Settings row shows only when useBoardLive (GymSettings.tsx:35,76) and the page hides mates and machine switches behind `live` (gym-sees.tsx:141-157); readBoard returns hidden without the Pro 'challenge' (leaderboardSync.ts:122-126) while machines/trainer have their own server switches. Today PLAN_GATE_ON=false (plans.ts:40), so it only bites offline/server error; the trainer block sits outside the `live` gate and What's new cards also link the page.

The outbox is kept per gym on the device until the next sign-in there (outbox.ts:15-17); lost() just clears the session and shows REMOVED_WORDS with no count (AuthProvider.tsx:151-165, signin.ts:399); the Remove sheet says 'payments stay as they are' (PeopleScreen.tsx:422); the only unsent warning guards signing out THIS device (PeopleScreen.tsx:473-481).

An archived existing member counts as in-branch (importSave.ts:182) so his term is saved by importTerms (local.ts:540-560), and neither importSave.ts nor importTerms (local.ts:540-660) ever touches archived; the import row only says 'Already a member (..., archived)' (importMembers.ts:1589-1590); lists exclude archived (audience.ts:52).

The server only checks the pause starts within 90 days and that some plan has not ended today (0044:199-209, the only definition); planFreeze adds the full pauseDays to the last-ending plan with no check of its endsOn against the pause or today (planRequests.ts:133-143), and the card extends by plan.days (PlanRequestsCard.tsx:56).

0048 says 'A member already linked is not touched' (0048:15) and only a number differing from checkin_phone is a typed try (0048:123-125); no later migration resets old links (phone_checked_at in 0068 is set only on new proofs) and the panel has no unlink call. Partly overstated: AppMembers.tsx lists app members with their number, so the gym can see them, just not undo them.

An applied server item remembers the SERVER's hash (copyPlan.ts:205-206; copyLocal.ts:378-385 overrides only the R-444 empty-workout case), so a phone that cannot keep speed/incline/level repacks to a different hash, counts it changed and resends it with editedAt=now (copyPlan.ts:88-93,105-108); PACK_VERSION is still 1 though F64 added fields (pack.ts:18,33) and nothing compares v on read (copyApi.ts:94).

gym_state counts grace/basic from greatest(paid_until, trial_ends_at) with no switch-on date (0062:84-91, the only definition); 0030 gave every old gym a trial ending 3 months after 0030 ran and promised nothing locks (0030:14-15,59-61). Latent: 0062 says NOT APPLIED LIVE and plan_gate is off, so it bites only when the switch is flipped.

billingState ignores trial_ends_at once a plan is set (logic.js:432-437) and has no grace/basic/read_only states, unlike gym_state's greatest() (0062:86). Narrower than claimed: an online or ledger payment during the trial starts paid time at trial end (_paid_from, 0063:175-178,249), so it only happens when HQ types a paid-until date by hand (hq_set_plan, 0030:147-170); the stages only matter once the plan lock is on.

Today's idea uses groupOf(d,'away',10) (suggestions.ts:148), which goes to answer.ts's days>0 branch: a running plan with 10+ days away (answer.ts:304-314); the See who follow-up asks for 'members who stopped coming' (answer.ts:324), i.e. days=0, the stoppedComingOn rhythm list (answer.ts:317-320), and the Messages group uses atRiskList (audience.ts:101-104).

A later file's receipts on an earlier import's term set same.priceP higher (local.ts:621-636); undo of that file deletes its receipts (undoImport.ts:57-60) but the term is not in its own list and nothing records or restores the old price (undoImport.ts has no priceP, local.ts:512-538 only filters rows), so dues rise by the removed receipts.
